title: Sketchnotes: Mindfulness and Mind-Fueling with Jewel
subtitle: Jewel Dropping Jewels
body_html:
Wander through the idea-map recap of our recent Clubhouse talk with the singer and writer Jewel on the clarity gained through mindfulness as well as the public confusion about it. 

Sketchnotes is a very different kind of drawn-out discussion, mapped and sketched out by Alejo Porras. It is a memorable and visual graphic of the key ideas and connections of our talks. If you’d like to see or hear more, subscribe to our Substack newsletter.  Since we’re brand-new, we have an ‘Early to the Frontier’ discount that gets you access to other subscriber-only content like info- and idea-packed wrap-ups, the most engrossing audio clips from our talks and invitations to exclusive Clubhouse events. 

And our Clubhouse conversations are expanding by the day. This summer, The Frontier Psychiatrists, Owen Muir, M.D. and Carlene Macmillan, M.D. will be rolling out engaging programming, with special guest interviews and talks on mental health debates, advances and controversies. We also have popular AMAs on topics like PTSD, Personality Disorders, and Depression with expert Psychiatrists and therapists and unexpected psych-adjacent collaborations with other Clubhouse creators to talk about music, food, fashion and more from a curious, mentalized point of view.

Our Substack page will be the home base for all of this — with your support, we will continue dedicating more and more time and resources to creating this new culture of important, fun and exceptional mental health programming.
